resolved_common.unit: USD millions; shares millions; percentages as decimal fractions
resolved_common.terminal_method: max(component-based net reinvestment, terminal NOPAT * g / incremental ROIC). Never add both. Terminal includes tax and ongoing content maintenance.

operating_policy.future_sbc: Core GAAP-like EBIT includes compensation cost. Allocation requires an explicit expense schedule for existing June unvested awards already included in that EBIT and removes only that schedule after tax before valuing those existing awards separately. Future-grant cash replacement excludes the removed existing-award expense. No broad SBC addback; no terminal existing-award addback. Allocation additionally enforces the remaining-expense total and recognition horizon, source-context admission limit under the no-positive-additions convention, and explicit retained compensation/other-cash-cost envelopes.
operating_policy.leases: Remain operating: expense retained in EBIT, no lease-debt subtraction and no ROU depreciation addback.
operating_policy.content: Cash spending includes additions and liability settlement; opening content liabilities and unrecognized content commitments are not deducted again as debt.
operating_policy.acquisitions: Future acquisition cash spending explicitly assumed 0; organic forecast, existing acquired assets embedded. H1 2026 acquisition already in June cash.
operating_policy.nonoperating_items: Termination fee and interest income excluded by beginning at operating EBIT; fee cash already in June cash and never added again.
operating_policy.tax_incentives: Content spending is net of incentives as represented by the filing cash-flow presentation; no extra incentive asset added to equity.
operating_policy.working_capital: Noncontent incremental operating investment assumption includes ordinary operating assets/liabilities and incentive timing. Excludes cash, debt, content assets/liabilities and separate claims.

policy.policy_label: ILLUSTRATIVE June allocation, analyst choices; not default or current target
policy.basis: $566m stale FY2025 gross tax-benefit amount is an explicit analyst income-tax reserve, plus $250m other claims. Additional Brazil exposure beyond the $729m already paid in H1 is deliberately assumed zero, not verified absent; the paid item is never reserved or settled twice and no recovery is credited. Face principal $14,372m excludes derivative fair values. Separately reserve the reported $13.574m interest-rate derivative net liability and assume $100m financing FX net liability because its exact fair value is not separately disclosed. No gross derivative, notional or debt carrying-basis deduction. Assume financing hedges close out July 1 at those values; total $929.574m separate cash settles in H2. Funding thereafter uses unhedged 4.9% interest and constant June FX assumptions. Existing-award expense embedded in EBIT is assumed $25m H2 2026, $25m 2027 and $10m 2028, zero thereafter; remove only its after-tax cost before separately allocating existing awards. This $60m is an explicitly reconciled remaining-expense assumption, not June reported unrecognized compensation. Its whole schedule must fit the selected December 2028 horizon, never beyond June 2029 under the supported three-year convention. Under the assumed absence of unmodeled positive modifications or other additions, the policy restricts total expense to the $47m plus 1.245383m x $82.91 = approximately $150.2547m source-context envelope. This is an analytical admission limit, not a verified June or legal ceiling. Retain 1.1% of each period revenue for future-grant cash-replacement compensation and 20% for other cash costs, already embedded in EBIT and never subtracted again. Future-grant compensation excludes the removed existing expense and cannot be below the explicit policy reference of FY2025 SBC/revenue. Cost components must fit jointly after content amortization and noncontent D&A. 2x award units is a sensitivity, not a legal maximum. Operating liquidity reserve $3bn is an assumption.

content_commitment_coverage.limitation: Necessary aggregate capacity only. Explicit first-half payment fraction is an analyst timing assumption. Passing does not prove title-specific, gross-versus-net incentive timing, intrayear liquidity, or coverage of subsequently signed commitments. No waiver of disclosed obligations is implemented.

existing_award_expense_envelope.source_context_basis: FY2025 rounded $47m unrecognized cost plus H1 2026 granted units 1.245383m times rounded weighted grant-date value $82.91. All H1 grants included even though some relate to prior-period PSU settlement. No reduction for H1 recognition or forfeiture is estimated. This is deliberately an analytical admission envelope only under the explicit no-unmodeled-positive-additions assumption, not exact June unrecognized expense, legal maximum or complete modification reconciliation. A larger amount or different award horizon requires a new supported implementation.
existing_award_expense_envelope.floor_basis: Restricted forward-cost convention assumes future-grant cash replacement intensity does not fall below FY2025 total SBC/revenue. This is an assumption anchored in reported history, not reported future expense; it excludes the separately removed existing-award expense.
existing_award_expense_envelope.timing_note: Any nonzero expense in the horizon year is assumed recognized by the stated horizon date. Annual PV and funding still book its adjustment at that year end, a conservative aggregation rather than exact recognition timing. Retained costs are embedded in EBIT and are not deducted a second time.

bear.funding_proxy_note: Annual capacity scenario, not actual cash forecast: retains adjusted FCFF, no buybacks/dividends/M&A/refinancing, June-FX face maturities. Financing hedges hypothetically close out July 1 and cash settles in H2 at the separately stated amounts; subsequent unhedged 4.9% interest and constant June FX are assumptions. Taxes use assumed operating rate. No option exercise proceeds; existing awards are noncash claims, not paid again. No second settlement of $729m Brazil cash already paid in H1. Intrayear dates and actual hedge closeout values are not verified.
bear.sbc_nonoverlap_note: Remove only the explicitly scheduled remaining expense for existing unvested June awards from assumed EBIT after tax, then allocate those awards separately. Future-grant cash replacement excludes that removed existing-award expense and remains a cost. All June options are vested. No broad SBC addback, no terminal addback and no separately assumed excess tax benefit. Schedule is an analyst assumption, not verified June grant-level expense, and must exactly reconcile to its explicit total, fit the supported recognition horizon, remain inside the no-positive-additions source-context envelope, and preserve explicit forward compensation and other cash costs. Cost floors are embedded in EBIT and never charged twice.
bear.approximation_warning: Weighted-strike/life Black-Scholes option proxy is not exact employee-option or grant-level fair value. Aggregate PSU multiplier is not a legal maximum. Face principal plus separate financing-hedge reserves is a conditional claim convention, not a complete market-value appraisal. Financing FX reserve, additional Brazil exposure, remaining existing-award expense, other claims and cash fungibility require explicit assumptions.
